initial_observation.summary: When an enrolled party is loaded or still loading and reconnect grace is zero, the selected operation resets the empty duration to zero, then returns Abandoned because zero is greater than or equal to zero. The selected caller maps abandonment to a failed terminal resolution. CLI source documents grace for an empty party and has an f32 argument without a local positive-range validator; supported invocation and end-to-end reach require independent confirmation.
initial_observation.historical_relationship: q3134 and ledger 406 already record a related zero-grace question; postf2c q2982 is an unadopted historical/current synthesis with its own attribution. No new defect count or alias is assumed.
